verdict.rationale: Numeral's docs show it manages filings/remittance as a first-class concept (an MCP 'filings' object, nexus monitoring, autofile/autoregister features, and an on-time filing guarantee), implying some ops-facing status tracking, but there is no evidence of a calendar view of upcoming returns, a dashboard showing amounts remitted per filing, or downloadable confirmation documents for submitted returns. missing for 10: calendar UI for upcoming returns, remitted-amount display per filing, downloadable filing confirmations.
